analysis.headline: Defensive Sectors and Select Emerging Markets Lead as Technology and Energy Fall to Multi-Month Score Extrema
analysis.market_regime: Broad Market Consolidation with Defensive Leadership and Style Rotation Toward Value and Equal Weight
analysis.executive_summary: Quantitative evidence across multiple horizons indicates relative strength shifting toward domestic defensive sectors, U.S. large-cap value, equal-weighted equities, and select international country markets such as India and the United Arab Emirates. Information Technology (XLK) and Oil Services (OIH) have hit 63-bar rotation score lows, while U.S. Large Cap Value (IWD) maintains strong pair leadership over Growth (IWF). Material sector divergences exist in Health Care and Communication Services, while pending raw trend changes provide early warning signals across several regional and thematic ETFs.

emerging_rotations.title: U.S. Real Estate Shows Emerging Relative Leadership
emerging_rotations.explanation: XLRE holds a confirmed EMERGING trend state with a rotation score of 73.41, driven by a 5-bar score change of +13.41 and a 20-bar score change of +36.82. Its 20-bar relative strength of +7.84% points and 63-bar relative strength of +5.17% points confirm multi-horizon improvement.

emerging_rotations.title: Biotechnology Displays Strong Short-Term Rotation Signal
emerging_rotations.explanation: XBI reached a confirmed EMERGING trend state with a score of 77.96, supported by a 5-bar score change of +27.59 and a 20-bar score change of +17.04. Relative strength is positive across both horizons, with 20-bar relative strength at +5.78% points and 63-bar relative strength at +2.71% points.

emerging_rotations.title: Pharmaceuticals Outpaces Broader Health Care Parent
emerging_rotations.explanation: XPH carries a confirmed EMERGING trend state with a rotation score of 71.85, advancing +19.26 points over 5 bars and +35.74 points over 20 bars. Its 20-bar relative strength of +8.91% points contrasts with a modest 63-bar relative strength of +0.52% points.

accelerating_rotations.title: Leisure & Entertainment Holds Confirmed Accelerating Trend
accelerating_rotations.explanation: PEJ maintains a confirmed ACCELERATING trend state with a score of 69.44, supported by 20-bar relative strength of +7.13% points and 63-bar relative strength of +7.09% points. However, Python notes a pending raw state change to NEUTRAL at 2 of 3 confirmation observations following a 5-bar score change of -10.0.

persistent_leaders.title: India Equity Maintains Outstanding Sustained Leadership
persistent_leaders.explanation: INDA holds a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER trend state and ranks first among 41 ex-US country ETFs with a rotation score of 93.84. Relative leadership is supported by a 20-bar score change of +46.65, 20-bar relative strength of +16.44% points, and 63-bar relative strength of +15.3% points.

persistent_leaders.title: Insurance Industry Reaches 63-Bar Score High
persistent_leaders.explanation: KIE holds a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state with a score of 91.48, achieving a 63-bar rotation score high. It exhibits consistent performance with a 5-bar score change of +11.85, 20-bar score change of +24.81, 20-bar relative strength of +9.94% points, and 63-bar relative strength of +9.13% points.

persistent_leaders.title: Consumer Staples Retains Top U.S. Sector Leadership
persistent_leaders.explanation: XLP holds a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state with a top-ranked U.S. sector rotation score of 85.91. Strength is evidenced by a 20-bar score change of +12.73, 20-bar relative strength of +10.44% points, and 63-bar relative strength of +14.27% points.

reaccelerating_rotations.title: Cybersecurity Holds Confirmed Reacceleration Despite Pending Warning
reaccelerating_rotations.explanation: CIBR carries a confirmed REACCELERATING state with a score of 50.93. Evidence across relative strength horizons is mixed: 20-bar relative strength is negative at -1.63% points while 63-bar relative strength remains positive at +4.22% points. Additionally, raw conditions flag a pending WEAKENING trend change at 2 of 3 confirmation bars following a 5-bar score change of -19.63.

weakening_rotations.title: Broad Health Care Sector Relative Strength Weakens
weakening_rotations.explanation: XLV carries a confirmed WEAKENING trend state with its rotation score falling to 54.09 following a 20-bar score change of -36.82 and a 5-bar score change of -17.27. Although long-horizon 63-bar relative strength (+13.13% points) and 20-bar relative strength (+5.42% points) remain positive, recent group rank dropped from 1st to 6th among U.S. sectors.

weakening_rotations.title: Global Energy Relative Momentum Deteriorates
weakening_rotations.explanation: IXC holds a confirmed WEAKENING state with a rotation score of 49.44 after a steep 20-bar score change of -44.56. Relative strength evidence across horizons is mixed, as short-term 20-bar relative strength is negative at -5.86% points while longer-term 63-bar relative strength remains positive at +5.05% points.

weakening_rotations.title: Taiwan Shows Severe Weakening with Pending Rotation-Out Warning
weakening_rotations.explanation: EWT carries a confirmed WEAKENING state with a score of 24.02 after suffering a 20-bar score change of -37.8. Both 20-bar (-13.07% points) and 63-bar (-10.83% points) relative strength are negative. Python identifies a pending ROTATION_OUT raw condition at 2 of 3 confirmation observations.

rotation_out.title: U.S. Information Technology Touches 63-Bar Score Low
rotation_out.explanation: XLK sits in a confirmed ROTATION_OUT state with a score of 13.18, marking a 63-bar rotation score low. It has registered a 20-bar score change of -24.09 and a 5-bar score change of -10.91, alongside negative 20-bar (-9.81% points) and 63-bar (-8.56% points) relative strength.

rotation_out.title: Oil Services Experiences Severe Multi-Week Deterioration
rotation_out.explanation: OIH sits in a confirmed ROTATION_OUT state at a score of 17.22, suffering the largest 20-bar score drop (-52.41 points) in the dataset. Relative strength is negative across both 20-bar (-7.33% points) and 63-bar (-9.74% points) horizons.

rotation_out.title: Brazil Remains Confirmed Rotation-Out Despite Pending Early Bounce
rotation_out.explanation: EWZ holds a confirmed ROTATION_OUT state with a score of 61.22. Although raw conditions show a pending EMERGING state at 1 of 3 confirmation observations following a 5-bar score change of +36.71, its confirmed trend state remains ROTATION_OUT. Its 20-bar relative strength is +5.07% points and 63-bar relative strength is +1.99% points.

geographic_rotations.title: India Leads Ex-U.S. Country Universe
geographic_rotations.explanation: INDA ranks first among ex-U.S. country ETFs with a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state and a score of 93.84. Relative leadership is confirmed by a 20-bar score change of +46.65, 20-bar relative strength of +16.44% points, and 63-bar relative strength of +15.3% points.

geographic_rotations.title: United Arab Emirates Sustains High Relative Leadership
geographic_rotations.explanation: UAE holds a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state with a score of 90.61. Outperformance vs benchmark ACWX is clear, with a 20-bar score change of +45.24, 20-bar relative strength of +20.53% points, and 63-bar relative strength of +22.1% points.

geographic_rotations.title: Developed Europe Outperforms Broad International Benchmark
geographic_rotations.explanation: VGK is a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER ranking first among ex-U.S. regions with a score of 85.0. It shows solid consistency with a 20-bar score change of +12.5, 20-bar relative strength of +2.6% points, and 63-bar relative strength of +2.46% points.

pair_relationships.title: U.S. Large Cap Value Holds Confirmed Pair Leadership Over Growth
pair_relationships.explanation: In the VALUE_VS_GROWTH pair relationship against paired ticker IWF, IWD holds a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER trend state and a PAIR_LEADING signal with a 20-bar pair spread of +8.67% points and a 63-bar pair spread of +11.09% points. Conversely, paired ticker IWF sits in a confirmed ROTATION_OUT state at a 63-bar score low of 5.16 with PAIR_LAGGING spreads of -8.67% points (20-bar) and -11.09% points (63-bar).

pair_relationships.title: Equal Weight S&P 500 Outperforms Cap-Weighted Parent
pair_relationships.explanation: In the EQUAL_WEIGHT_VS_CAP_WEIGHT pair relationship against paired ticker SPY, RSP maintains a confirmed PAIR_LEADING signal with a 20-bar pair spread of +4.58% points and a 63-bar pair spread of +4.42% points, even as RSP's broad confirmed cross-sectional state is WEAKENING at a score of 63.90.

cross_market_confirmations: Defensive sector relative strength is confirmed across domestic Consumer Staples (XLP, score 85.91) and Global Consumer Staples (KXI, score 92.22).
Real Estate rotation is confirmed across domestic sector ETF XLRE (score 73.41), sub-industry ETF REZ (score 80.19), and REIT benchmark VNQ (score 78.06).
Technology relative weakness is confirmed across U.S. Information Technology (XLK, score 13.18), Global Technology (IXN, score 22.78), and Cloud Computing (SKYY, score 25.56).
risks_or_conflicts: Sector Divergence in Health Care: Sub-industry Pharmaceuticals (XPH, 20-bar score change +35.74) is improving, whereas parent Health Care (XLV, 20-bar score change -36.82) is deteriorating, creating a 72.56-point internal sector divergence.

Sector Divergence in Communication Services: Global Communication Services (IXP, 20-bar score change +30.56) is improving, whereas Internet (FDN, 20-bar score change -27.22) is deteriorating, creating a 57.78-point internal sector divergence.

Pair State Tension in RSP vs SPY: RSP holds a confirmed PAIR_LEADING signal against paired ticker SPY with a 20-bar pair spread of +4.58% points, but its broad confirmed trend state is WEAKENING (score 63.90) due to recent 5-bar (-0.61) and 20-bar (-12.51) score declines.

Pending Raw Trend Changes: Raw daily conditions differ from confirmed trend states for CIBR (confirmed REACCELERATING, pending WEAKENING 2/3 bars), EIRL (confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER, pending WEAKENING 2/3 bars), EWT (confirmed WEAKENING, pending ROTATION_OUT 2/3 bars), and EWZ (confirmed ROTATION_OUT, pending EMERGING 1/3 bars).
analysis.methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
